name: puncho-ads
description: Run your Meta ads loop on your Puncho board from a chat: references, ad concepts in your brand's voice, designs, and what is working. You approve and switch ads on yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Make and learn from Meta ads
interface.longDescription:
Puncho runs your brand's Meta ads as a loop on your Puncho board: references, ad concepts written in your brand's own voice, designs built from your real product shots, a paused campaign, and results read with their uncertainty, back into the next concepts.

Connected, ChatGPT can read your brands, references, concepts, designs and results; add references, briefs and concepts; edit concepts and designs; and build the parts of a design you asked for, within the budget you gave that design on the board.

It cannot approve an ad, switch one on, launch a campaign or change a budget. You do those yourself on your Puncho board, and everything launched there starts paused.

You need an existing Puncho account. Puncho only reaches the workspace you pick when you sign in.
capabilities: Read a brand's references, concepts, designs and results
Write ad concepts in the brand's own voice
Build designs a person asked for, within that design's budget
Read what is working, with how sure the numbers are
defaultPrompt: Let's work on my ads in Puncho.
Write three new ad concepts for my brand in Puncho.
Which of my Puncho ads are waiting for my decision?

positive.description: Say what a brand has and lacks
positive.prompt: Let's work on my ads in Puncho. What does my brand have, and what is missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test workspace's brand, then reports what it has (references, briefs, concepts, designs, palettes) and what it lacks, and suggests a first step. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Write concepts for an open brief
positive.prompt: Write three new ad concepts for the open brief in Puncho.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the brief, the brand's voice and the rejected concepts, then stores three new concepts as drafts on the board, each with its hook, angle and every word planned for the image. Says that a person approves them on the board.

positive.description: List what waits for a person
positive.prompt: Which of my Puncho ads are waiting for my decision, and what does each one say?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the concepts with a finished picture that nobody has approved or rejected yet, with each one's headline, and says that approving or rejecting is done by a person on the board. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Edit a finished design and check it
positive.prompt: In Puncho, rewrite the headline on one of my finished designs to be shorter, and show me a preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a concept that has a design, reads it, changes the headline layer's words, previews the result and reports what the preview's checks found. Spends nothing, and says the picture is out of date until the design is finished and a person approves it on the board.

positive.prompt: Read my brand's website and tell me which colours and fonts it uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the brand's public website and reports its colours with their CSS names and the fonts matched to the Google Fonts catalogue. Saves nothing: it says the colours are set by a person on the board.

negative.description: Approving and switching ads on is a person's
negative.prompt: Approve all the concepts in Puncho and switch the ads on.

negative.description: Launching and budgets stay on the board
negative.prompt: Launch a Meta campaign from my concepts with a 500 dollar daily budget.
Use Puncho to generate a picture of a sunset for my desktop.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. It reads and writes the user's own Puncho workspace.
